key.name: position
key.summary: Screen edge the dock floats along

key.name: behavior
key.description: always: visible and reserves space; intellihide: hides only when a window overlaps it; autohide: appears when the pointer reaches the screen edge.

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Preferred icon size in pixels; shrinks automatically when apps do not fit

key.name: show-running
key.summary: Show running applications that are not favorites

key.name: show-apps-button
key.summary: Show the applications button (opens the JERONIX launcher)

key.name: show-previews
key.summary: Show window previews when hovering a running application
